note: Majority: not read. Samoa's legislation sites (the Office of the Legislative Assembly at palemene.ws, the Samoa Law Reform Commission, gov.ws) answered with a captcha or not at all, and PacLII refused with a Cloudflare check; null. Work: Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 (consolidated text published by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour), section 51(1): no one may engage or employ a child under sixteen in work except light work; (2): a child of at least thirteen may do light work that is unlikely to harm health and development, doesn't keep the child from school or affect schooling, and complies with regulations; (3): no one under eighteen in hazardous work. Performers: the Act names no exception or permit for performing, so barred under sixteen (my reading), save as light work from thirteen within subsection (2), which the form doesn't hold. Service: Samoa keeps no armed forces; no law on a call-up was read; null.
